t: Told to be upright, and it turned his hair grey
a: فَٱسْتَقِمْ كَمَآ أُمِرْتَ وَمَن تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا۟ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
p: Fa-staqim kamā umirta wa man tāba maʿaka wa lā taṭghaw…
m: So remain on a right course as you have been commanded, [you] and those who have turned back with you [to Allāh], and do not transgress. Indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
